Penyelarasan Lampu Jajar

The navigation technique of steering a vessel so that two range lights, one behind the other, appear vertically aligned, indicating the vessel is on the safe channel axis.

Questions and answers

What is Penyelarasan Lampu Jajar?

In this glossary, Penyelarasan Lampu Jajar refers to: The navigation technique of steering a vessel so that two range lights, one behind the other, appear vertically aligned, indicating the vessel is on the safe channel axis.

How is Penyelarasan Lampu Jajar used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Pertahankan arah kapal agar kedua lampu jajar sejajar. Jika lampu terpisah, koreksi arah dan laporkan ke VTS jika perlu."

Definition

The navigation technique of steering a vessel so that two range lights, one behind the other, appear vertically aligned, indicating the vessel is on the safe channel axis.

Operational example

Keep the vessel’s heading so that both range lights appear in line. If lights separate, correct course to regain range light alignment and notify VTS if necessary.

Localized term

Penyelarasan Lampu Jajar

Localized example

Pertahankan arah kapal agar kedua lampu jajar sejajar. Jika lampu terpisah, koreksi arah dan laporkan ke VTS jika perlu.
